parsed.why: Unenforced 14-year same-sex statute with no recorded prosecutions; no trans-specific data, targeting, or violence documented. Thin record with hostile elite rhetoric and no protections — extrapolated to Elevated, not severe.

Decriminalised on paper but morality/cybercrime laws, activist crackdowns, coerced venue closures and a 10-year penalty for gender-affirming care show active state targeting; 93% social rejection. Worse than an unenforced statute.

Law makes trans depiction pornographic (4–13 years), propaganda statute bans reassignment advocacy; 8 trans people detained in a month with custody abuse and coerced charges. State-directed targeting of trans visibility itself.

Extremism designation drives 101 convictions, bar raids, arrests for flags, a death in custody, and a ban on gender reassignment; 74% hostility. Organised state campaign, marginally less trans-visibility-specific than dossier 3.

Decriminalised by upheld court ruling and 2026 deletion, courts ordered trans marker recognition and community registration, no documented anti-trans violence; but no administrative LGR and thin implementation of precedents.
